title: RAW UNREVIEWED: removal reverses an exposure effect
summary: Seek a complete dated medical or natural-philosophy case in which a named exposure precedes a bodily change and its withdrawal precedes recovery, with an explicit rival cause or unchanged-exposure case in the same source. Freeze the source chronology, patient identity and counterfactual before any admitted manuscript reading. A complete candidate reading must distinguish a reversible causal sequence from a static prognosis or unrelated treatments. Neither a relevant Voynich patient nor a translated exposure word is known; the earlier Hippocratic prognosis proposal IDEA000396 is a different history-dependent judgment question.

design.mechanism: source-owned exposure and withdrawal form a directed effect-reversal sequence for one patient
design.unit: one complete dated case with its source-written alternative and one complete already admitted candidate passage
design.contrast: reversible exposure effect versus a static prognostic sign or independent treatments
design.prediction: a predeclared whole reading keeps exposure, changed state, withdrawal and recovery in causal order under one patient identity; missing target binding yields no test
